post.summary: Ask a question about a course
post.description: Stores the question and the answer in a chat: a new one when `chat_id` is null. The answering model reads the course's whole MAIS sheet and the community answers most similar to the question, and cites them as [n]; every [n] has a source: the exact sheet text, or the community answer with its question, author, date and Overené / Neoverené. When the sources do not answer the question, `found` is false ('Neviem'). A backend without the model (local development) answers with a placeholder: one real section of the sheet; a question with the word 'neviem' gets 'Neviem'.

404.description: Unknown course, or the chat does not exist / is not yours.

422.description: Invalid question, or the chat belongs to another course.

503.description: Login or database not configured, or the answering model is not available (rate limit, network): nothing is stored, the question can be sent again.
